0x001892.en: 「Even if I am now branded a traitor...!」

0x0018CC.en: 「Now is the time to show/　the way by force!」

0x001919.en: 「I will unify all of La Gias/　and build a peaceful world!」

0x00196F.en: 「All the blame rests on me.../　I must be the one to end this!」

0x0019CB.en: 「I fight by my own conviction!/　I cannot change it now!」

0x001A33.en: 「Jaohm is an old model in the end./　No match for a newer machine!」

0x001A92.en: 「A Masou Kishin, is it.../　Relying on surface-dwellers/　was the mistake from the start!」

0x001B0D.en: 「Cybuster.../　That a Masou Kishin could change the world this much./　Then there's no reason I cannot too!」

0x001BAC.en: 「Tytti,/　I'd like to think you aren't swayed by feelings...」

0x001C08.en: 「In a crisis like this,/　someone must rule by force./　Why can't you see that!」

0x001C89.en: 「Princess Xenia, forgive my rudeness./　Please get to safety.」

0x001CE8.en: 「Princess Xenia, riding a Norse into battle/　is pure recklessness.」

0x001D41.en: 「Daughter of Sword King Zeoruto.../　however gifted you are,/　I cannot lose to a mere little girl!」

0x001DD1.en: 「Children have no place on the field!/　Leave the fighting to adults!」

0x001E36.en: 「Princess of the surface world.../　step onto this field, and you'd better be ready!」

0x001E9E.en: 「You turn against me too, Gennacy./　Why does no one value what I've achieved!?」

0x001F06.en: 「So you truly mean to fight me, Zashford.../　I'll say it once more - I'll show no mercy!」

0x001F80.en: 「That stubbornness is your mother's.../　no, perhaps mine./　If so, what a cruel fate...!」

0x00200A.en: 「A shame, Yang Long./　You understood my fight./　But if you've turned against me... I'll strike you down!」

0x002097.en: 「I am supreme commander./　The one who bears all responsibility./　So I will never give up - not until the end!」

0x002127.en: 「Parted ways or not, you were once my comrade./　It pains me to cut you down, but it must be done!」

0x0021AD.en: 「Not after coming this far.../　I won't so easily throw away/　everything I've achieved!」

0x00222E.en: 「Zamzeed's new pilot./　So the Masou Kishin/　will not side with me after all...!」

0x0022B2.en: 「If only Zamzeed's pilot were Ricardo.../　no, it's pointless to say so now.」

0x002326.en: 「A child, yet a Masou Kishin pilot./　I dare not let you go!」

0x002385.en: 「Surface-dweller.../　block my path, and I'll show no mercy!」

0x00242E.en: 「Surface-dweller or not, if you deny my cause.../　I'll strike you down!」

0x002704.en: 「Guh!/　Does it rival a Super Masou Kishin!?」

0x002757.en: 「Grrgh.../　You'd stand in my way to the last!」

0x0027EB.en: 「Gaddess.../　A Masou Kishin truly is strong...!!」

0x002838.en: 「I-impossible,/　that Princess Xenia could do this...!」

0x002980.en: 「Facing Valsione as a foe/　was troublesome...!!」

0x002BBE.en: 「Not bad, Gaddess.../　but this is just the start!」

0x002C0B.en: 「You've improved, Princess Xenia./　Still, this won't bring me down.」

0x002C7F.en: 「Ho... natural talent, is it./　But Presia, your finish is weak!」

0x002D21.en: 「Give it up, Zashford!/　You cannot beat me!」

0x002D6B.en: 「A hit.../　but weak for a Granveil!」

0x002DC4.en: 「I see, quite the wild filly, Lune.」

0x002E0A.en: 「Hm... underestimated the little girl?/　So it's Zamzeed's power.」

0x002F28.en: 「Don't take a Super Masou Kishin lightly.」

0x002F62.en: 「Aren't you the one/　misusing your own power?」

0x002FB5.en: 「Heh, I can win... I really can./　Even Cybuster's attack only does this much!」

0x003023.en: 「A blow or two, no more!/　Even Gaddess lacks the power!」

0x0030B9.en: 「Give it up, Presia. Attacking is futile.」

0x00316A.en: 「This is no place for you to butt in!/　Zashford, stand down!」

0x0031C9.en: 「Gone rusty, Yang Long?/　Don't tell me you're holding back.」

0x003231.en: 「Good arm, Lune./　But sadly, too weak.」

0x003332.en: 「What's wrong? You're disgracing the Cybuster name!」

0x00336C.en: 「You're not giving this your all, Tytti!」

0x0033D4.en: 「Zeoruto's daughter or not, still a child.../ Too soft!」

0x003427.en: 「I taught you the blade, Zashford!/　Reading you is child's play!」

0x003492.en: 「I'd rather not take a hit/　from Granveil!」

0x0038E3.en: 「Feel the power of the Super Masou Kishin!」
